name: Outlier Test
description: Run classical outlier tests (Grubbs, Dixon Q, Generalized ESD, Tukey IQR, Hampel, Z-Score) in parallel on a column
whenToUse: When a measured characteristic may contain outliers: tests one numeric column with up to seven methods (Grubbs, Dixon Q, generalized ESD, Tukey IQR, Hampel, Z-score, modified Z-score) and reports which values each method flags; requires at least 3 numeric values.
tipTukeyFactor: Factor for Q1 − k·IQR / Q3 + k·IQR. 1.5 marks 'potential', 3.0 'extreme' outliers.
tipHampelK: Threshold in MAD units (1.4826·MAD ≈ σ under normality). Default k = 3.
tipZThreshold: Threshold in standard deviations — typically 3. Distorted by masking on small samples.
tipEsdMax: Maximum number of outliers ESD will check. Leave blank for auto: ⌊n/4⌋, capped at 10.
err_dixonRange: The Dixon test only applies to 3 to 30 values.
hintDegenerateMad: MAD = 0 (more than half the values are identical). Method yields no result.
hintDegenerateSd: Standard deviation = 0 (all values identical). Method yields no result.
placeholderText: Pick a numeric column — outlier tests are computed automatically.

invariants.enabledNotEmpty: At least one method must be enabled
